notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Default TCP SYN scan (-sS) against localhost or single target. Sends SYN per port without completing handshake — half-open scan. SYN-ACK = open, RST = closed, no response = filtered. Requires root for raw socket access.

=== PORT STATES ===
open: service accepting connections — primary target.
closed: host alive, port reachable, nothing listening — confirms host is up.
filtered: no response or ICMP error — firewall in path, needs bypass technique.
unfiltered: only in ACK scans — reachable but open/closed indeterminate.

=== DEFAULT BEHAVIOR ===
Without sudo: Nmap falls back to -sT (Connect scan). With sudo: -sS by default. Always run as root for SYN scan performance and stealth benefits.
